verdict.rationale: Gmail's own Gemini features generate insights and suggestions from the user's mail inside the product. Documented examples are thread summaries, one-click suggested replies, meeting-time proposals based on Google Calendar availability, and draft refinement. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of these AI features, and evidence of insights across the whole mailbox (trends or analytics) beyond per-thread summaries and suggestions.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: Summarize: Synthesize long email threads into concise bullet points.
Schedule: Propose meeting times based on your availability in Google Calendar.
Gemini in Gmail saves you time drafting or polishing emails, and suggested replies help you reply in one click, in your voice.
